notes: One-page reference guide, version 04-24, read from the PDF text in a browser (the site refuses GitHub's servers, so CI can't score it). Eligibility is 'dwellings located in the United States', labeled all_states. Excluded places include 'COBRA Zone' (labeled cbrs), 'Barrier Islands' and, by name, 'Block Island, RI', Fire Island, Monroe County FL and others; the schema has no kind for a named locality, so those are not labeled. 'Dwelling Maximum Value: $3,000,000' is total_insured_value and 'Maximum Limit: $1,000,000' is dwelling. Other structures (10%) and loss of use (20%) are percentages and aren't labeled. Log cabins, condemned, pre-1900, major renovation and coastal basements are one 'other' exclusion.

property_exclusions.detail: log cabins, condemned properties, dwellings built before 1900, major renovation, coastal dwellings with a basement
